summary: Build advanced payroll management skills in controls, reconciliation, HRIS data, and reporting. Practise with real payroll artefacts and enrol today.
lede: Payroll management helps experienced payroll and finance professionals verify gross-to-net results and control the end-to-end process. It develops practical skills in validating master data and pay calculations, reconciling payroll registers to the general ledger, investigating exceptions, documenting approvals and audit evidence, and reporting payroll risks.
audienceIntro: Advanced payroll management is suited to professionals who already handle payroll cycles, payroll data, accounting entries, HRIS workflows, or compensation controls and now need to improve assurance across the full payroll process.
modules: Payroll Data Security and Audit Evidence
prerequisites: You should have practical experience supporting or overseeing at least one payroll cycle and working knowledge of payroll registers, employee master data, deductions, payroll journals, and basic reconciliations. Familiarity with an HRIS or payroll platform is useful, but no specific vendor platform is required. No programming is required for completion. Advanced automation and AI-assisted payroll validation are covered at operational application level, while participants practise spreadsheet analysis, control design, reconciliation, and dashboard planning.
